message.content: {"answer": "D", "option_text": "The resolution of lung infiltrates is consistent with recovery from exercise-induced pulmonary haemorrhage (EIPH).", "reason": "Visual inspection confirms extensive bilateral patchy opacities in the initial image (figure_1.jpg) and near-complete clearance in the final image (figure_4a.jpg), verified by chest_xray_classifier scores dropping from 0.92 (Lung Opacity) to no strong findings. While chronology is not explicitly bound by metadata, the dramatic resolution of diffuse hemorrhagic-appearing infiltrates without residual fibrosis or cardiomegaly is clinically characteristic of EIPH recovery, distinguishing it from ARDS (which typically leaves fibrosis) or bacterial pneumonia (less likely to present with such symmetric diffuse patterns resolving this cleanly)."}
